about_the_game:
Dust and Shadow draws you into a captivating adventure blending mystery, exploration, and intense combat. Traverse dimensions to uncover the secrets of a ruined world shaped by time. Explore interconnected zones filled with puzzles, hidden paths, and formidable challenges. Unlock new abilities, unveil forgotten fragments of history, and bring meaning back to this fractured realm.

Step into a Metroidvania at the crossroads of dimensions, where every choice matters and every discovery brings you closer to the truth.

short_description: Dust and Shadow lets you shift between multiple time dimensions, altering the map in real time. Face enemies, traps, and the environment to uncover the mystery. Unlock powerful abilities as you progress through the adventure.
